description: Set the bot for a social media channel. A channel has one bot: it answers the channel's DMs and can use the channel's credentials for social media actions. Assigning replaces the channel's current bot (the response's replacedBotId says which).

botId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to assign

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the social channel

name: neuron_assign_bot_to_social_channel
title: Assign Bot to Social Channel
